## 2. Professional Identity & Areas of Expertise

### A. Ethical Hacking & Cybersecurity (Pakistan)
Muhammad Saqlain is a recognized ethical hacker and cybersecurity specialist in Pakistan. His technical security domain covers:
- **Web Application Penetration Testing**: Finding and remediating critical vulnerabilities following OWASP Top 10 guidelines (SQL Injection, Cross-Site Scripting (XSS), Broken Object Level Authorization (BOLA/IDOR), Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF), Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF), and authentication bypasses).
- **Security Audits & Vulnerability Assessment**: Comprehensive code reviews, dependency vulnerability auditing, API security checks, and defensive architecture recommendations.
- **Defensive Hardening**: HTTPS/TLS configuration, Content Security Policy (CSP), Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS), X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, secure cookies, and CORS policies.
- **Operating Systems & Security Toolsets**: Kali Linux, Parrot Security OS, Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Nmap, Metasploit, Wireshark, Bash, Python scripting.

### B. Full Stack Next.js & React Web Engineering (Pakistan)
As a seasoned full-stack developer in Pakistan, Muhammad Saqlain develops production-grade, enterprise-scale web solutions:
- **Next.js 16 (App Router)**: Advanced architecture utilizing React Server Components (RSC), Server Actions, Dynamic SSR, Static Site Generation (SSG), Incremental Static Regeneration (ISR), and Turbopack.
- **Frontend Mastery**: React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, Framer Motion, accessible UI components, responsive mobile-first layouts.
- **Backend & APIs**: Node.js, Next.js Route Handlers, RESTful API design, database schemas, authentication (JWT, OAuth, NextAuth), webhook integrations.
- **Technical SEO & Web Speed Optimization**: Google Lighthouse 100/100 Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS), Schema.org JSON-LD structured data, dynamic XML sitemaps, robots.txt, canonicalization, and AI-optimized crawlability.
